method.collision: 15-axis SAT on full rectangular prisms using CARD_W/H/T; penetration >1e-6 world units counts, including packets.
method.camera: Exact signed eye-to-OBB distance after sceneFrame: negative is inside. Positive clearance is reported without an assumed camera radius. Eye/view consistency is checked.
method.bounds: Uses cameraPose(progress).vp. All corner bounds are enforced only at p<=.04 and p>=.985. Middle viewport/nav/footer and near-plane excursions are intentional and informational. Conservative nav/footer bands are not DOM text measurements.
method.continuity: Largest sampled pose and camera differences are refined eight times at fixed state. Descending progress is compared with the ascending evaluation to check reversibility.
method.limits: Finite sampling does not prove all-progress separation or continuity.
